title: Fulfillment/refund and finance adapters
scope_items: Acceptance Target 1 (I01–I10 plus payment races): Built adapters for TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, and Stripe with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, webhook ingestion, returns, refunds, settlements, and polling delta computation. Handled reservation expiry racing payment confirmation with late recovery when sellable stock exists and fail-closed rejection when stock is exhausted, preventing overselling. Concurrent payment webhooks execute idempotently with atomic row locking.

Acceptance Target 2 (Correcting fees preserve proof - F06): Built UpdateFeeBreakdown and RecordOrderCorrection appending reversal postings pointing to previous posting IDs via reversal_of, followed by v2 corrected fee postings. Gross revenue remains immutable while fee modifications update net profit in the M19 Operating Ledger.

Acceptance Target 3 (No double refund/restock): Enforced physical return and money refund orthogonality (RULE-M13-006). Validated cumulative returned quantity <= purchased line quantity and cumulative refund <= captured order amount. Idempotent return receipt and refund approval replay without duplicate inventory movements or ledger postings.
Web & Mobile Support: Built TypeScript and Dart client models, exact micros decimal arithmetic, boundary validators, platform capability evaluators, and polling delta helpers.

Order, Inventory, and Finance Suites Verified: Full test suite in internal/order, internal/inventory (including I01-I10), and internal/finance (including F01-F09) pass with -race.
